A time zone is a zone. The time zone is any of the 24 regions of the globe (loosely divided by longitude) throughout which the same standard time is used.
A time deposit is a certificate of deposit. The time deposit is a certificate of deposit from which withdrawals can be made only after advance notice or at a specified future date.
A Roman times is a times. The Roman times is the time period during which Rome dominated Europe.
An elapsed time is a time period. The elapsed time is the time that elapses while some event is occurring.
A duration is a time period. The duration is the period of time during which something continues. It is also called continuance.
A time of life is a time period. The time of life is a period of time during which a person is normally in a particular life state.
An arrival time is a point. The arrival time is the time at which a public conveyance is scheduled to arrive at a given destination. It is also called time of arrival.
A relaxation time is a time constant. The relaxation time is the time constant of an exponential return of a system to equilibrium after a disturbance.
A time period is a fundamental quantity. The time period is an amount of time. It is also called period of time and period.
To time is a way to adjust. To time is to regulate or set the time of.
A time exposure is an exposure. The time exposure is exposure of a film for a relatively long time (more than half a second).

A time deposit account is a savings account. The time deposit account is a savings account in which the deposit is held for a fixed term or in which withdrawals can be made only after giving notice or with loss of interest. It is also called deposit account.
A time note is a note. The time note is a note that specifies the time (or times) of repayment.
A time constant is a ratio. The time constant is the ratio of the inductance of a circuit in henries to its resistance in ohms.
A present is a time. The present is the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech. It is also called nowadays.
A civil time is a time. The civil time is the official time in a local region (adjusted for location around the Earth); established by law or custom. It is also called standard time and local time.
A coordinated universal time is a Greenwich Mean Time. The coordinated universal time is Greenwich Mean Time updated with leap seconds. It is also called UTC.

A transmission time is a coordinated universal time. The transmission time is the coordinated universal time when a transmission is sent from Earth to a spacecraft or other celestial body. It is also called TRM.

An Eastern Time is a civil time. The Eastern Time is standard time in the 5th time zone west of Greenwich, reckoned at the 75th meridian; used in the eastern United States. It is also called Eastern Standard Time and EST.
A fast time scale is a time scale. The fast time scale is (simulation) the time scale used in data processing when the time-scale factor is less than one.
A moment is a point. The moment is a particular point in time. It is also called minute, second and instant.
To time is a way to adjust. To time is to adjust so that a force is applied and an action occurs at the desired time.
A point is a measure. The point is an instant of time. It is also called point in time.
A time is a moment. The time is a suitable moment.
A high time is a time. The high time is nearly past the time when something should be done.
A triple time is a musical time. The triple time is musical time with three beats in each bar.
A reaction time is a time interval. The reaction time is the time that elapses between a stimulus and the response to it. It is also called response time, latency and latent period.
To time is a way to schedule. To time is to assign a time for an activity or event.
To time is a way to determine. To time is to set the speed, duration, or execution of.
A time sheet is a written record. The time sheet is a record of the hours worked by employees.

An extended time scale is a time scale. The extended time scale is (simulation) the time scale used in data processing when the time-scale factor is greater than one. It is also called slow time scale.
A time limit is a time period. The time limit is a time period within which something must be done or completed.
A run-time is a run. The run-time is (computer science) the length of time it takes to execute a software program.
A common time is a musical time. The common time is a time signature indicating four beats to the bar. It is also called four-four time, quadruple time and common measure.
A double time is a pace. The double time is a fast marching pace (180 steps/min) or slow jog.
A lead time is a time interval. The lead time is the time interval between the initiation and the completion of a production process.
A processing time is a time interval. The processing time is the time it takes to complete a prescribed procedure.
To break down is a way to suffer. To break down is to collapse due to fatigue, an illness, or a sudden attack. It is also called collapse.
To fall over is a way to break down. To fall over is to fall forward and down. It is also called go over.
To break into is a way to utter. To break into is to express or utter spontaneously.
To change is a way to induce. To change is to cause to change; make different; cause a transformation. It is also called alter and modify.
To differ is a way to change. To differ is to be different.
A change is a relation. The change is a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event.
To change state is a way to change. To change state is to undergo a transformation or a change of position or action. It is also called turn.
To change by reversal is a way to change. To change by reversal is to change to the contrary. It is also called turn and reverse.
To change is a way to act. To change is to become different in some particular way, without permanently losing one's or its former characteristics or essence. It is also called alter and vary.
To better is a way to change. To better is to to make better. It is also called improve, amend and ameliorate.
To affect is a way to change. To affect is to have an effect upon. It is also called impact, bear upon and bear on.
To remake is a way to produce. To remake is to make new. It is also called refashion, redo and make over.
To effect is a way to cause. To effect is to produce. It is also called effectuate and set up.
To transform is a way to change. To transform is to change or alter in form, appearance, or nature. It is also called transmute and transubstantiate.
To change shape is a way to change. To change shape is to assume a different shape or form. It is also called change form and deform.
To darken is a way to change. To darken is to become dark or darker.
To adjust is a way to change. To adjust is to alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard. It is also called set and correct.
A time is an attribute. The time is the continuum of experience in which events pass from the future through the present to the past.

A time and motion study is an examination. The time and motion study is an analysis of a specific job in an effort to find the most efficient method in terms of time and effort. It is also called time-and-motion study, time-motion study and motion study.
A clock is a timepiece. The clock is a timepiece that shows the time of day.
A time clock is a clock. The time clock is clock used to record the hours that people work.
A timepiece is a measuring instrument. The timepiece is a measuring instrument or device for keeping time. It is also called timekeeper and horologe.
A time exposure is a photograph. The time exposure is a photograph produced with a relatively long exposure time.
A timing is a temporal arrangement. The timing is the time when something happens.
A face time is a work time. The face time is work time spent at the location of or in the presence of other people.

A Greenwich Mean Time is a time. The Greenwich Mean Time is the local time at the 0 meridian passing through Greenwich, England; it is the same everywhere. It is also called Greenwich Time, GMT and universal time.

A Mountain Time is a civil time. The Mountain Time is standard time in the 7th time zone west of Greenwich, reckoned at the 105th meridian west; used in the mountain states of the United States. It is also called Mountain Standard Time and MST.
A time being is a present. The time being is the present occasion. It is also called nonce.
An integer is a number. The integer is any of the natural numbers (positive or negative) or zero. It is also called whole number.
A remainder is a number. The remainder is the number that remains after subtraction; the number that when added to the subtrahend gives the minuend. It is also called difference.
A multiplier is a number. The multiplier is the number by which a multiplicand is multiplied. It is also called multiplier factor.
To interact is a way to act. To interact is to act together or towards others or with others.
To meet is a way to act. To meet is to get together socially or for a specific purpose. It is also called get together.
To touch is a way to act. To touch is to make physical contact with, come in contact with.

To transact is a way to interact. To transact is to conduct business.
A credit is an assets. The credit is money available for a client to borrow.
A balance is a remainder. The balance is the difference between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account.
An account is a relationship. The account is a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services. It is also called business relationship.
A derivative instrument is a legal document. The derivative instrument is a financial instrument whose value is based on another security. It is also called derivative.
An instrument is a device. The instrument is a device that requires skill for proper use.
A debt instrument is a document. The debt instrument is a written promise to repay a debt. It is also called obligation and certificate of indebtedness.
To call is a way to order. To call is to order or request or give a command for.
To call in is a way to call. To call in is to make a phone call.

To call in is a way to call. To call in is to summon to a particular activity or employment.
A call is a visit. The call is a visit in an official or professional capacity.

To call is a way to read. To call is to read aloud to check for omissions or absentees.
To call in is a way to invite. To call in is to summon to enter.

To call is a way to request. To call is to call a meeting; invite or command to meet.
To visit is a way to meet. To visit is to pay a brief visit. It is also called call in and call.
To call on is a way to visit. To call on is to to visit someone, usually for a short time.
To work is a way to exert. To work is to be employed. It is also called do work.
An employment is an action. The employment is the act of giving someone a job. It is also called engagement.
An one-way light time is an elapsed time. The one-way light time is the elapsed time it takes for light (or radio signals) to travel between the Earth and a celestial object. It is also called OWLT.
A light time is a distance. The light time is distance measured in terms of the speed of light (or radio waves).
To work is a way to exert. To work is to exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity; work.
A work is an activity. The work is activity directed toward making or doing something.
To work is a way to transform. To work is to shape, form, or improve a material. It is also called work on and process.
To use is a way to act. To use is to put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose. It is also called utilize, utilise and apply.
To fall all over is a way to interact. To fall all over is to display excessive love or show excessive gratitude towards.
To fall into is a way to constitute. To fall into is to be included in or classified as. It is also called fall under.
To plan is a way to think. To plan is to make plans for something.
A goal is a content. The goal is the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it. It is also called end.

A relationship is a state. The relationship is a state involving mutual dealings between people or parties or countries.
To tell is a way to inform. To tell is to let something be known.
An indication is a communication. The indication is something that serves to indicate or suggest. It is also called indicant.
A call is a decision. The call is (sports) the decision made by an umpire or referee.
To call is a way to declare. To call is to declare in the capacity of an umpire or referee.
A call fire is a fire. The call fire is fire delivered on a specific target in response to a request from the supported unit.
A roll call is an utterance. The roll call is calling out an official list of names.
A call-back is an employment. The call-back is the recall of an employee after a layoff.
A telephone is a telecommunication. The telephone is transmitting speech at a distance. It is also called telephony.
A call is a telephone. The call is a method of contacting a person by phone. It is also called phone call and telephone call.
A call-back is a call. The call-back is a return call.
A local call is a call. The local call is a telephone call made within a local calling area.
A conference call is a call. The conference call is a telephone call in which more than two people participate.
A call is an instruction. The call is an instruction that interrupts the program being executed.
A bell-like call is a birdcall. The bell-like call is a birdcall that resembles the tone of a bell.
A call is a demand. The call is a demand for a show of hands in a card game.
A call option is an option. The call option is the option to buy a given stock (or stock index or commodity future) at a given price before a given date. It is also called call.
A call center is a center. The call center is a center equipped to handle a large volume of telephone calls (especially for taking orders or serving customers). It is also called call centre.
A collect call is a call. The collect call is a telephone call that the receiving party is asked to pay for.
A call-in is a call. The call-in is a telephone call to a radio station or a television station in which the caller participates in the on-going program.
A function call is a call. The function call is a call that passes control to a subroutine; after the subroutine is executed control returns to the next instruction in main program.
A system call is a call. The system call is an instruction that interrupts the program being executed and passes control to the supervisor. It is also called supervisor call instruction.
A call mark is a mark. The call mark is a mark consisting of characters written on a book; used to indicate shelf location. It is also called call number and pressmark.
A margin call is a demand. The margin call is a demand by a broker that a customer deposit enough to bring their margin up to the minimum requirement. It is also called call.
An artifact is a whole. The artifact is a man-made object taken as a whole. It is also called artefact.
A structure is an artifact. The structure is a thing constructed; a complex entity constructed of many parts. It is also called construction.

A fabric is an artifact. The fabric is artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers. It is also called cloth, material and textile.
To move is a way to change. To move is to cause to move or shift into a new position or place, both in a concrete and in an abstract sense. It is also called displace.
A motion is a change. The motion is the act of changing location from one place to another. It is also called movement and move.
To travel is a way to act. To travel is to change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically. It is also called go, move and locomote.

To have is a way to change. To have is to undergo. It is also called experience.
To undergo is a way to change. To undergo is to go through.
To stop is a way to interrupt. To stop is to interrupt a trip. It is also called stop over.
To lay over is a way to stop. To lay over is to interrupt a journey temporarily, e.g., overnight. It is also called stop over.
To change magnitude is a way to change. To change magnitude is to change in size or magnitude.
To decrease is a way to change magnitude. To decrease is to decrease in size, extent, or range. It is also called diminish, lessen and fall.
A magnitude is a property. The magnitude is the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small).
A size is a magnitude. The size is the physical magnitude of something (how big it is).
A scale factor is a multiplier. The scale factor is a number used as a multiplier in scaling.
A rate is a magnitude relation. The rate is a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit.
A way is an artifact. The way is any artifact consisting of a road or path affording passage from one place to another.
A travel is a motion. The travel is the act of going from one place to another. It is also called traveling and travelling.
A journey is a travel. The journey is the act of traveling from one place to another. It is also called journeying.
A trip is a journey. The trip is a journey for some purpose (usually including the return).
To guide is a way to travel. To guide is to pass over, across, or through. It is also called run, draw and pass.
To order is a way to request. To order is to give instructions to or direct somebody to do something with authority. It is also called tell, enjoin and say.
To order is a way to request. To order is to make a request for something.
To call to order is a way to open. To call to order is to open formally.
An order is a command. The order is (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed.
To hold one's own is a way to control. To hold one's own is to maintain one's position and be in control of a situation.
To hold over is a way to intimidate. To hold over is to intimidate somebody (with a threat).
To hold over is a way to stay. To hold over is to continue a term of office past the normal period of time.
To hold over is a way to keep. To hold over is to keep in a position or state from an earlier period of time.
To exist is to have an existence, be extant. It is also called be.
A presence is a being. The presence is the state of being present; current existence.
A thereness is a presence. The thereness is the state of being there — not here — in position.
A thereness is a presence. The thereness is real existence.

A writing is a written communication. The writing is the work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect). It is also called written material and piece of writing.
A writing is a written communication. The writing is letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language.
To write is a way to trace. To write is to mark or trace words or symbols on a surface.
To print is a way to write. To print is to reproduce by printing. It is also called impress.
To like is a way to feel. To like is to find enjoyable or agreeable.
To feel like is a way to desire. To feel like is to have an inclination for something or some activity.
A like is a kind. The like is a similar kind. It is also called the like and the likes of.
A liking is a feeling. The liking is a feeling of pleasure and enjoyment.
To run is a way to move. To run is to move along, of liquids. It is also called flow, feed and course.
A run is a time period. The run is the continuous period of time during which something (a machine or a factory) operates or continues in operation.
A running time is a time period. The running time is the length of time that a movie or tv show runs.
To run into is a way to hit. To run into is to collide violently with an obstacle. It is also called bump into, jar against and butt against.
To spend is a way to pay. To spend is to pay out. It is also called expend and drop.
An outgo is a transferred property. The outgo is money paid out; an amount spent. It is also called spending, expenditure and outlay.
A cost is an outgo. The cost is the total spent for goods or services including money and time and labor.
A spendthrift is a prodigal. The spendthrift is someone who spends money prodigally. It is also called spend-all, spender and scattergood.
A time machine is a machine. The time machine is a science fiction machine that is supposed to transport people or objects into the past or the future.
A time sharing is a sharing. The time sharing is (computer science) the use of a central computer by many users simultaneously.
A past is a time. The past is the time that has elapsed. It is also called past times and yesteryear.
A time immemorial is a past. The time immemorial is the distant past beyond memory. It is also called time out of mind.
An abstraction is an entity. The abstraction is a general concept formed by extracting common features from specific examples. It is also called abstract entity.
A psychological feature is an abstraction. The psychological feature is a feature of the mental life of a living organism.
A group is an abstraction. The group is any number of entities (members) considered as a unit. It is also called grouping.
A category is a concept. The category is a general concept that marks divisions or coordinations in a conceptual scheme.
To impart is a way to tell. To impart is to transmit (knowledge or skills). It is also called leave, give and pass on.
To displease is a way to induce. To displease is to give displeasure to.
An actor is a causal agent. The actor is a person who acts and gets things done. It is also called doer and worker.
A contestant is an actor. The contestant is a person who participates in competitions.
A good time is an experience. The good time is a highly pleasurable or exciting experience. It is also called blast.
A big time is a success. The big time is the highest level of an occupation (especially in entertainment).
An animal communication is a signal. The animal communication is communication between animals (of the same species).
A birdcall is an animal communication. The birdcall is the characteristic sound produced by a bird. It is also called call, birdsong and song.
An acknowledgment is a message. The acknowledgment is a statement acknowledging something or someone. It is also called acknowledgement.
A greeting is an acknowledgment. The greeting is (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting). It is also called salutation.
A structure is an artifact. The structure is a thing constructed; a complex entity constructed of many parts. It is also called construction.
A creation is an artifact. The creation is an artifact that has been brought into existence by someone.
An attitude is a cognition. The attitude is a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways. It is also called mental attitude.
An inclination is an attitude. The inclination is an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others. It is also called disposition and tendency.

A female is a person. The female is a person who belongs to the sex that can have babies. It is also called female person.
A prostitute is a woman. The prostitute is a woman who engages in sexual intercourse for money. It is also called cocotte, whore and harlot.

To take out is a way to induce. To take out is to cause to leave. It is also called move out and remove.

To start is a way to begin. To start is to get off the ground. It is also called start up, embark on and commence.
